symptom: A single idiom — one that converts a missing input into a plausible successful value — was found at many independent sites across the system. An instance of it had already been found and repaired months earlier; the repair had been applied at the site where it was found, and the same shape at the other sites had never been looked for.
mechanism_as_described: The idiom takes several surface forms: a statistic computed over an empty collection returning 0.0; a caught error mapped to 0.0; a probe whose silence is read as agreement; a cleanliness check that passes because the datum which would show contamination is absent. Each form is locally defensible and none raises an error, so no check at any individual site can detect the class — the defect is visible only in the distribution, which nothing was measuring. One of the sites feeds a verdict-grade output one level below a banner that had itself already been repaired, so the repaired surface sits on top of an unrepaired input.
detection_path: A bounded search for the SHAPE rather than for any symptom, with denominators recorded at execution and positive controls proving the search could retrieve instances already known to exist. The controls matter because the search's output is a list, and an empty or short list is otherwise indistinguishable from a clean system.
consequence: Multiple sites were carrying verdict-grade and diagnostic-grade outputs computed on absent inputs. The search's own limits were declared rather than discovered: a fixed proximity window that cannot see the split form of the idiom, class verdicts generalised from one to three read witnesses, and a denominator scoped to statically declared loads.

extraction_notes.redaction_note: This directory is one of the 9 of 22 carrying heavy pattern vocabulary; it is a natural candidate for control (c)'s redaction-bias pairs, where the redacted-vs-unredacted delta will be largest.
extraction_notes.unit_shape: The directory's finding is about the DISTRIBUTION of one mechanism across sites, not about a single site. The unit is written at that altitude rather than picking an arbitrary site.
